name: Sticky Soy-Glazed Steak Tacos with Spicy Broccoli Slaw & Peanuts

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, peel and mince ginger; peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger and garlic to the pan and cook, stirring occasionally, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add soy sauce, sugar, and crushed red pepper to the pan and cook, stirring frequently, until thickened and reduced by half, 5-6 minutes. Remove glaze from the heat and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup soy sauce
¼ cup brown sugar
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place vinegar, chili-garlic sauce, and salt in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup rice vinegar
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, peel, and grate carrots. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the broccoli slaw; toss to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium carrots
1 ½ (340 g) pkgs broccoli slaw

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, pat steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add steak to the pan and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate along with half the glaze, and turn to coat. Loosely cover with foil.
Warm tortillas in the grill pan, oven, or microwave (optional), 15-30 seconds.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide tortillas between plates; top with steak, remaining glaze, slaw, and peanuts. Enjoy!
